references.label: Joints & ligaments · detail
references.description: Z-Anatomy joint capsules, ligaments, discs and matching optional bone context in source coordinates.

references.label: Endocrine glands · detail
references.description: Thyroid, parathyroids, pituitary lobes, pineal, adrenals and pancreas. Gonads remain in the male and female body references.

references.label: Adult male · BodyParts3D
references.description: Full-body reference with separately modeled systems.

references.label: Adult female · Human Reference Atlas
references.description: Female organ reference including reproductive anatomy. Some whole-body systems have partial coverage.

references.label: Lymph nodes & organs · detail
references.description: Z-Anatomy lymph nodes and organs in their own source reference coordinates; lymph vessels are not included.

references.label: Inner & middle ear · detail
references.description: SPL high-resolution ear reference, including the labyrinth, ossicles, membrane, nerves and vessels.
